description: PAID tool ($0.10 USDC via x402 v2, Base). Create a short-lived, origin-scoped browser delegation session. Send the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header on the /mcp request; without payment the call returns the live x402 challenge (HTTP 402, amount 100000 = $0.10 USDC, network eip155:8453). Actions inside a minted session are unmetered. Optionally target a previously enrolled trusted device using its private 256-bit routing capability so its extension can claim the session automatically. The user still handles login/CAPTCHA and any new browser-origin permission themselves.
name: ghostkey_session_create
